title: Best AI Character Designers (2026): Consistent AI Characters
description: How to hire an AI character designer for mascots, avatars or story characters: consistency, editing, rights, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: AI character designers use AI image tools plus editing to create characters for brands, games, books, social media and avatars. The hardest part is consistency: keeping the same face, outfit and style across many images. A good designer combines prompt skills with manual editing and clear character sheets. Projects go wrong when characters change between images, look like existing famous characters, or rights for commercial use are unclear. This guide helps you get original AI characters you can use.

faq.q: Can I use the character commercially?
faq.a: Check the AI tool's terms and agree on usage rights with the designer. Rules on owning AI images vary by country.

faq.q: Can I get a character sheet?
faq.a: Ask for front, side and expression views, plus color notes.

faq.q: Can the character be animated later?
faq.a: Yes, but animation may need cleaner, redrawn art. Discuss future plans.
